relief_4.speaker: lyra
relief_4.text: The abbey will keep our wounded and our records. From here, the causeway is one march. If we lose the road, we come back here and take it again.

relief_4.speaker: faye
relief_4.text: I sent word along the hunting paths. People heard what happened at the river. They are coming because someone stayed to help.

relief_4.speaker: vela
relief_4.text: The lighthouse can manage without me. Give me a place in the column.

relief_4.speaker: dax
relief_4.text: And me. We learned to hold a line on the docks. We can learn the rest together.

relief_4.speaker: lyra
relief_4.text: You are welcome here. You are not replacements for names on a list. Tell us what you can do, and we will make room.

relief_8.speaker: lyra
relief_8.text: The monastery is our last rally point. Leave copies of the charts here. If the engine's guards drive us back, the next attempt starts with what we can still carry.

relief_8.speaker: galen
relief_8.text: There are beds in the old seed house. Nobody has to earn one by being useful.

relief_8.speaker: yuna
relief_8.text: I can get close to the palace patrols. I know when they turn, and which doors they leave unguarded.

relief_8.speaker: hale
relief_8.text: I helped dig the engine's foundations. Let me help bring it down.

relief_8.speaker: lyra
relief_8.text: Then we plan with the people standing here. We remember everyone who brought us this far.

retreat_0.speaker: lyra
retreat_0.text: They carried me back to Cinderford. The patrols have closed the crossing again. We will have to open it from this side.

retreat_0.speaker: lyra
retreat_0.text: The lost do not return because I survived. Keep their names in the book. Count the people and supplies we still have, then we decide how to move.

retreat_4.speaker: lyra
retreat_4.text: We are back at the abbey. While we withdrew, the regent's troops retook the causeway. The eastern road is closed again.

retreat_4.speaker: lyra
retreat_4.text: I will not call this a fresh beginning. We carry every loss into the next march. But the granary is still ours, and there are people here willing to walk with us.

retreat_8.speaker: lyra
retreat_8.text: The monastery bell brought the scattered companies home. The guards have sealed the engine approaches. We start again from Starfall.

retreat_8.speaker: lyra
retreat_8.text: Keep the charts. Keep the promises we made for the fallen. I am alive because someone brought me out, and I mean to make that matter.

volunteer_faye.speaker: faye
volunteer_faye.text: I heard a name on the road. Someone who stood with your company, and will not be going home.

volunteer_faye.speaker: lyra
volunteer_faye.text: I wish the news had been better.

volunteer_faye.speaker: faye
volunteer_faye.text: So do I. I was going to meet you on the Kingsroad. I can walk beside you before then.

volunteer_noor.speaker: noor
volunteer_noor.text: The reports reached the observatory. I kept calculating how long we had. All the while, people were paying for that time.

volunteer_noor.speaker: lyra
volunteer_noor.text: Your work may still be what saves the valley.

volunteer_noor.speaker: noor
volunteer_noor.text: Then I will bring it with me. I am done asking other people to hold the road alone.

memorial_0.speaker: lyra
memorial_0.text: We will enter their names in the company book tonight. Leave room beside each one for the people who should hear from us when the roads are open.

memorial_0.speaker: lyra
memorial_0.text: They left instructions with the quartermaster. The sealed supplies are for whoever can carry the work forward. We will honor those instructions before the next march.

memorial_0.speaker: lyra
memorial_0.text: Cinderford has no monument for this company. For now, we keep the book dry, bring each other home when we can, and make sure their families hear more than a name.

memorial_4.speaker: lyra
memorial_4.text: The abbey has offered us a shelf in its record room. I am leaving a copy of our company book here. If the causeway closes behind us, their names will still have a way home.

memorial_4.speaker: lyra
memorial_4.text: The quartermaster has set aside the supplies they entrusted to us. Take what the next march needs. Tell the new arrivals whose hands kept this company together.

memorial_4.speaker: lyra
memorial_4.text: At dawn we count the people who can travel, the wounded who need beds, and the promises we are still able to keep. The road east will be planned around that company.

memorial_8.speaker: lyra
memorial_8.text: The monastery bell has stopped, but the room is still listening. Leave the company book open until everyone who wishes to write in it has had their turn.

memorial_8.speaker: lyra
memorial_8.text: Their last requests came with supplies for the engine road. The quartermaster will see them carried out. Whatever reaches the gates with us will carry a part of this march.

memorial_8.speaker: lyra
memorial_8.text: When the engine falls silent, there will be letters to deliver and places to return to. Keep those addresses with the charts. We are planning the journey home as well.
